_meta.note: arXiv 2607.16235 OpenMHC (Stanford): My Heart Counts wearable benchmark (11,894 participants) — prediction (32 tasks), imputation, forecasting; LSM-2 and WBM are the authors' reimplementations (not Google/Apple weights).

models.name: LSM-2 (OpenMHC reimplementation)
models._note: Authors' open reimplementation of Google's LSM-2 masked autoencoder (Xu et al. 2025b), pretrained on OpenMHC minute-level data; NOT Google's released weights (google/lsm-2).

models.name: LSM-2-Sparse (7-day, OpenMHC)
models._note: Frozen daily LSM-2 encoder + sparse cross-day decoder for 7-day long-context imputation (OpenMHC App. F.2.2).

models.name: LSM-2 (7-day, OpenMHC)
models._note: Weekly (7-day) LSM-2 variant used in long-context imputation (Table 20/22 only).

models.name: LSM-2 WBM-Cohort (minute, OpenMHC)
models._note: LSM-2 reimplementation pretrained only on WBM-eligible participants, minute-level input (Table 17 controlled comparison).

models.name: LSM-2 WBM-Cohort (hourly, OpenMHC)
models._note: LSM-2 reimplementation pretrained on WBM-eligible participants with hourly-aggregated input (Table 17).

models.name: WBM (OpenMHC reimplementation)
models._note: Authors' reimplementation of Apple's Wearable Behavior Model (Erturk et al. 2025; bidirectional Mamba-2, contrastive), pretrained on OpenMHC hourly weekly tensors. Falls back to Linear for 62.8% of eval instances in Table 2.

models.name: Linear (OpenMHC prediction reference)
models._note: Linear/logistic regression on summary features; prediction reference (S=0).

models.name: Chronos-2 (fine-tuned on OpenMHC)
models._note: Amazon Chronos-2 fine-tuned (LoRA) on OpenMHC train split.

models.name: Toto 1.0 (fine-tuned on OpenMHC)
models._note: Datadog Toto 1.0 fine-tuned on OpenMHC train split.

models.name: LOCF (OpenMHC imputation reference)
models._note: Last observation carried forward; imputation reference (S=0).

models.name: DLinear (OpenMHC)
models._note: DLinear trained from scratch (PyPOTS for imputation; global model for forecasting).
